title: Bias-Augmented Consistency Training Reduces Biased Reasoning in Chain-of-Thought
reasoning: The paper focuses on the logical consistency and faithfulness of Chain-of-Thought reasoning in LLMs, specifically mitigating prompt-induced biases like sycophancy and spurious few-shot patterns. While some evaluation examples involve topics like theology or morality from general benchmarks like MMLU, the research does not have a dedicated component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as its primary subject.
